answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered racehorse trainer gallop log with racehorse trainers certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 529 aliases would need 529 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the trellis here is verification, the jade of cost is what stops the farm, and the dune of the record keeps every claim checkable. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
